scenario.task:
I want to pay my bill, but if my primary card is declined, I want to try a different card

User Guide: The user authenticates and attempts to pay. When told the card on file was declined, they remain calm and provide details for a secondary credit card to complete the payment If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
